The question states they agree to split the bill equally so they will pay £20 each.

== 5% ==
Look at this shape. The top two rows contain four triangles of the same size. Including the top two rows, how many of those triangles are needed in total to fill this shape?
[[File:Triangle2.png|frameless]]


Each row increases by two triangles so the next rows will have 5, 7 and 9 triangles. 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = '''25'''
